meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让网页界面更美观、更流畅、更易用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常写前端页面/组件,却拿不准视觉细节与性能表现
copy.tagline_en: Make web interfaces more beautiful, smoother, and easier to use
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build frontend pages or components, unsure about visual polish and performance

howto.what: 前端工作时,会把请求路由到对应设计/品牌/性能等规则集,并要求先建立或遵守 DESIGN.md 设计系统;在真实 Chromium 中用 Lighthouse 跑 100 分审计;做视觉 QA 逐像素比对参考稿后输出代码。
howto.when: 提到 frontend、design、React 等触发词,或要求改样式、做布局、动画、重构、性能与无障碍审计等前端/视觉工作时触发。

say.text: 把新版首页做成类似 Linear 的极简风格
say.note: 触发品牌参考加载与 DESIGN.md 编写。

say.text: 运行视觉 QA,把当前页面和设计参考图逐像素对比
say.note: 产出差距清单及修复建议。

say.text: 让这个 React 页面的 Lighthouse 跑满 100 分
say.note: 触发真实浏览器审计与性能修复。

howto.what_en: When doing frontend work, Claude routes to the relevant reference sets, requires a DESIGN.md contract, audits with Lighthouse in real Chromium for 100 scores, and does pixel-level visual QA against the reference, then outputs code.
howto.when_en: Triggers on frontend/visual requests: when you mention keywords like 'frontend', 'design', 'React', or ask for page styling, layout, animation, redesign, performance/accessibility audits, etc.

say_en.text: Recreate the homepage in Linear's minimal style.
say_en.note: Loads the brand reference and writes DESIGN.md.

say_en.text: Run visual QA comparing the page against this design.
say_en.note: Produces a diff list and fixes.

say_en.text: Get this React page to Lighthouse 100.
say_en.note: Runs real-browser audit and perf fixes.
